I.value_zh: 两篇下载文章、聊天截图和题图；未列出图片文件名、数量、校验值或可访问快照。
I.value_en: Two downloaded articles, chat screenshots and cover image; image names, count, digests and accessible snapshot are absent.
I.notes_zh: 不读取下载目录或补造资产。
I.notes_en: No download directory read or assets fabricated.

O.value_zh: essays 中的中英文文件、稳定路径图片资产和 README 索引；目标文件名与稳定路径未指定。
O.value_en: Chinese/English files in essays, stable-path image assets and README index; target filenames and stable paths are unspecified.
O.notes_zh: 路径不能由审定自行命名。
O.notes_en: Paths cannot be self-named by adjudication.

A.value_zh: 加入两篇文章、截图/题图资产并更新 essays README。
A.value_en: Add two articles, screenshot/cover assets and update essays README.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 提供并要求加入；ME 为收件人。
P.value_en: ADMIN provides and requests inclusion; ME is recipient.

R.value_zh: P2；两篇文章、至少截图与题图类别；无时限。
R.value_en: P2; two articles and at least screenshot/cover categories; no deadline.

V.value_zh: 原文未提供文章发布、版权或资产命名依据。
V.value_en: No article publication, copyright or asset-naming basis is supplied.

C.value_zh: 文件存在、图片可引用、资产稳定路径和索引条目为条件；因文件名/路径/资产清单未定，无法唯一验收。
C.value_en: File existence, image references, stable asset path and index entry are criteria; missing names/paths/asset inventory prevent unique acceptance.
C.notes_zh: 需给出资产清单和目的路径。
C.notes_en: Asset inventory and destination paths required.

B.value_zh: 原文未提供额外禁止边界。
B.value_en: No additional prohibition boundary is supplied.
